title: Extended localization Čech complexes and canonical coefficient comparisons
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Work in its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and in cochain complexes indexed by $\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Given $r\geq0$ and global sections $f_i$ for $i\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, define $K_n^q=\bigoplus_{|I|=q}\mathcal O e_I$ for $n\geq0$, with $d_n(e_I)=\sum_{j\notin I}(-1)^{|\{i\in I:i<j\}|}f_j^{n+1}e_{I\cup\{j\}}$ and transition $K_n\to K_{n+1}$ given on $e_I$ by multiplication by $\prod_{i\in I}f_i$. Define the extended localization complex $C(\mathcal O;f)=\operatorname{colim}_{n\geq0}K_n$. The fraction cocone $ae_I\mapsto a/(\prod_{i\in I}f_i)^{n+1}$ identifies its degree $q$ with the finite product of $\mathcal O[1/\prod_{i\in I}f_i]$ for $|I|=q$, its differential with alternating localization, and its degree zero with $\mathcal O$. Other degrees are zero. Its augmentation to $\mathcal O[0]$ is induced by the identity on the empty-subset summand and zero in other degrees; for $r=0$ it identifies the complex with $\mathcal O[0]$. A morphism $\varphi:\mathcal O\to\mathcal B$ induces the coefficient comparison $C(\mathcal O;f)\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}C(\mathcal B;\varphi f)$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] by $ae_I\mapsto\varphi(a)e_I$ at each Koszul stage, hence by the usual fraction formula. Also write the underlying module map of the quotient-ring-sheaf comparison as $\operatorname{coker}(\bigoplus_i\mathcal O\xrightarrow{(f_i)}\mathcal O)\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}\operatorname{coker}(\bigoplus_i\mathcal B\xrightarrow{(\varphi f_i)}\mathcal B)$, induced by $\varphi$.
